messages:
sam: Alert - ap-south1 scratch NVMe IOPS spiked to ~195k for 12m. GPU attach delays and pod pending climbing. infra-bot fired.
infra-bot: [ALERT] scratch_nvme_iops > 180000 (ap-south1) - 12m. see /dash/scratch-ap-south1 and /runbooks/attach-backpressure.md
priya: pattern looks like many small reads from image layer dedupe + concurrent GC sweep. pending gpu pods ~64.
owen: we pushed the aggressive GC last night to recover space; that plus parallel image pulls is likely the culprit.
lucy: short plan: 1) throttle GC (set GC_SWEEP_RATE=0.3), 2) pause aggressive dedupe for 45m, 3) enable image-prefetch cache for hot layers. scoped to ap-south1.
sam: agree. prefer to avoid cross-region spill but have it as fallback. paste commands.
priya: hotpatch commands (ap-south1 namespace):
```
kubectl set env deployment/gc GC_SWEEP_RATE=0.3 -n infra-ap-south1
kubectl set env deployment/image-service ENABLE_LAYER_DEDUPE=false -n infra-ap-south1
kubectl set env daemonset/image-cache PREFETCH_MODE=hot-layers -n infra-ap-south1
kubectl scale deployment/gc --replicas=1 -n infra-ap-south1
```
owen: applying now. monitoring iops.
[priya reacts :eyes:]
infra-bot: [ACTION] gc env patched by owen (GC_SWEEP_RATE=0.3)
own: iops trending down 195k -> 58k in ~9m, attach pending 64 -> 8. good signal.
lucy: enabling prefetch reduced read amplification immediately. keeping flags for 60m.
sam: if we need to spill, route 20% of new GPU allocations to ap-southeast1 for up to 2h. cost estimate?
finance-bot: est extra cost ~$140/hr for 20% spill to ap-southeast1. auto-approve threshold reached, confirm ops want to proceed.
priya: not required now. we'll hold spill as backup. filing RFC for adaptive-gc and prefetch policy: /docs/rfcs/adaptive-gc-prefetch.md
own: scheduling retro with scheduler and storage owners tomorrow 10:00am. leaving alert sensitivity raised for 3h.
sam: nice quick patch team. :thumbsup: closing unless we see more attach failures.
